value.rationale: The authors identify nonexpanding parameter dynamics as an open direction; the reflection-symmetric locus is an intrinsic invariant of the neuron map rather than an arbitrary numeric slice. Its exact classification exposes a four-orbit coexistence wedge, two different collision mechanisms, and a region with two simultaneously attracting asymmetric spiking two-cycles. These are structural low-period constraints, not mere isolated numeric instances.
